evidence.title: Harvard’s $699 startup bootcamp offers AI avatars of its instructors

summary: Harvard introduced a low‑cost startup bootcamp that uses AI‑generated avatars of its instructors to deliver course content, aiming to make entrepreneurial education more affordable and scalable. Priced at $699, the program leverages generative AI to simulate faculty interactions, sparking discussion about AI’s role in higher‑education instruction.
title: Harvard Launches $699 Bootcamp Featuring AI Instructor Avatars
